subject: Phased activation blueprint & owner tapestry — MAP draft and timeline
messages:
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@lumenhealth.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Phased activation blueprint & owner tapestry — MAP draft and timeline

Hi Claire / Alex —

Thanks again for yesterday's call. Per our discussion I put together a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (attached) that splits the onboarding into three phased activations so we can get a limited feature set live quickly and then expand. High-level:

- Phase A (2 weeks): test environment, auth, basic prompt templates, and first 2 intents.
- Phase B (4 weeks): expanded templates, telemetry + cost guardrails, SSO + RBAC.
- Phase C (2–3 weeks): integrations (EMR connector), scaled routing rules, runbook for incidents.

I've assigned provisional owners in the sheet — Ben will lead the CS acceptance gates, Neha will own implementation milestones, and Kimberly (me) will manage overall timeline and executive cadence.

Please review the MAP and the timeline PDF. Specific asks from you:
1) Confirm Phase A go/no-go criteria (we proposed: smoke tests pass, sample throughput 10rps, and security checklist 1 completed).
2) Share procurement point of contact for contract redlines and any vendor ACLs (we'll loop Mark from contracts if needed).
3) Let us know if the proposed go-live window (target pilot: 2028-03-12) fits your calendar.

I'm attaching Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx and Implementation-Timeline-2028Q1.pdf. If helpful we can run a short 30‑minute sync Thursday to lock owners.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Implementation-Timeline-2028Q1.pdf (timeline + milestones)

From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@lumenhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@lumenhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phased activation blueprint & owner tapestry — MAP draft and timeline

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and the attachments. Quick answers:

1) Phase A criteria look reasonable to me. I will confirm with Alex on throughput — our initial target for the pilot is ~8–12rps, so that aligns.
2) Procurement contact: procurement@lumenhealth.com (cc'd) — they'll want a short SOW and SLAs laid out.
3) 2028-03-12 pilot window is acceptable. We do have a calendar blackout week the week of 3/20 for internal audits; would prefer critical acceptance testing before that.

Couple of asks from our side:
- Can you add a security evidence column to the MAP sheet (SOC2 checklist items, data retention, log access)?
- We need a short list of required IAM roles and a sample SAML metadata file for SSO set up.

If Ben and Neha are available Thursday at 11am PT we can do the sync — that works for Alex and me.

Best,
Claire
Director of Product Integrations | Lumen Health
claire.dawson@lumenhealth.com

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@lumenhealth.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 10:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phased activation blueprint & owner tapestry — MAP draft and timeline

Claire / team —

Thanks — I updated the MAP spreadsheet with a "Security Evidence" column and populated the first pass: SOC2 type II report location, data retention default (30 days KV cache, 365 days logs), and where audit logs will be accessible. See tab "SecurityNotes" in the XLSX.

I've also sketched acceptance criteria for Phase A in the sheet:
- Auth: SAML test user can log in and list models
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for short prompts during smoke run
- Cost: token burn < estimated threshold for trial (we'll set alerting)

Neha, can you confirm estimated human effort for Phase B (we currently show 2 FTE-weeks, please adjust).

I'm available for Thu 11am PT. I'll bring the MAP and a short checklist we can use to sign off Phase A in the meeting.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@lumenhealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phased activation blueprint & owner tapestry — MAP draft and timeline

Hi all —

Quick readout after reviewing the MAP: Phase B will require approximately 3 FTE-weeks of engineering time and 1.5 FTE-weeks of implementation/CS involvement (integration, telemetry, and RBAC work). I've updated the timeline PDF to reflect that change and shifted Phase B completion out one week to account for the effort.

Notes added to the timeline:
- Owner tags: Neha_K (Implementation Lead), Ben_C (CS Acceptance), Claire_D (Customer Product Lead), Alex_T (Customer IT).
- Contingency window: two business days after Phase A for remediation, otherwise push pilot by one week.
- Escalation path: if Phase A fails security evidence checks, escalate to Kimberly + Mark (Contracts) within 24 hours.

I've also added the SAML metadata sample and an IAM role mapping doc link in the MAP (tab "Auth"). Ben: I left the acceptance checklist in the sheet — feel free to edit before the call.

I'll join Thu 11am PT.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@lumenhealth.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@lumenhealth.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phased activation blueprint & owner tapestry — MAP draft and timeline

Team —

Great sync today. Short recap and next steps:

- Pilot target: 2028-03-12 (Phase A) — acceptance checklist to be completed by Ben and Claire by 2028-03-09.
- Owners locked: Neha (implementation), Ben (CS acceptance), Alex (customer IT), Claire (product lead), Kimberly (executive sponsor).
- Procurement: procurement@lumenhealth.com to share SOW template and any contract constraints by 2028-02-21.
- Deliverables this week: final MAP v1.xlsx (Ben will publish v1.1), Implementation-Timeline-2028Q1.pdf (Neha updated), SAML metadata sample (Neha).

If anyone needs the meeting notes or the action tracker, I uploaded the summary to the shared doc (link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-MAP-draft) and added the high‑priority tasks in the top sheet.

Call out: Claire, you mentioned a blackout week 3/20 — we'll ensure no critical acceptance steps fall in that window.

Thanks everyone — I'll follow up Monday with the updated MAP and the calendar invites for the weekly 30-minute check-in.

Best,
Kimberly
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
